generalization_sets.rationale: Person is defined as a human individual; Organization is an organized social entity. The current model does not close Agent to these two kinds.
generalization_sets.example: A person and an employing organization are different agents.
generalization_sets.counterexample: An organization must not be merged with a human representative; an unmodeled agent kind is not excluded by a covering axiom.

dispositions.disposition: Retain the case kind and separate document, scenario and result identities. Labels and scores supply no equality rule.
dispositions.example: Two entries and two scenarios may concern the same case.
dispositions.counterexample: Do not merge cases merely because labels or scores match.
dispositions.remaining_evidence: OWL non-entailment and query evidence remain pending.

dispositions.disposition: Retain the abstract stereotype for non-spatiotemporal information content, independently of isAbstract=false.
dispositions.example: InformationContent may classify concrete informational meanings under the current design.
dispositions.counterexample: Do not replace the abstract stereotype with a UML abstract-class flag.
dispositions.remaining_evidence: Content equivalence still requires an explicit interpretation policy.

dispositions.disposition: Retain role and roleMixin classifications; their mediation targets inherit through the role hierarchy. Responsible and authorizing classifications may overlap across mandates.
dispositions.example: One human may be responsible in one mandate and authorizing in another.
dispositions.counterexample: Do not impose global disjointness between the responsible and authorizing role classes.
dispositions.remaining_evidence: Each actual mandate still requires distinct mediated participants; instance-level checks belong to the formal profiles.

dispositions.disposition: Retain recorded assignment information without inferring a real relator; use grounding, scope and validity in mandate identity, not the actor pair alone.
dispositions.example: The same actors may participate in separate renewed mandates.
dispositions.counterexample: Do not fabricate a second actor to satisfy participant distinctness or merge renewed mandates by actor equality.
dispositions.remaining_evidence: Identity resolution and participant distinctness require explicit fixtures in later formal/application checks.

dispositions.disposition: Retain EvidenceItem as a contextual role of InformationArtifact; the mandatory incoming pointsToEvidence relation records the evidential-use context.
dispositions.example: The same artifact is evidence for one claim without becoming evidence for every claim.
dispositions.counterexample: A source link must not become an endorsement or proof of its target.
dispositions.remaining_evidence: The ordinary use relation does not provide a complete formal theory of evidential truthmaking; adequacy is reviewed independently.

dispositions.disposition: Retain intrinsic-mode typing and exactly one bearer at the source end of bearsVulnerability. Keep the external object category as a modeling anchor, not a claim of resolved OWL import.
dispositions.example: An asserted vulnerability inheres in one externally identified substantial object.
dispositions.counterexample: A description alone must not create an actual vulnerability, and zero or two bearers must not satisfy managed admission.
dispositions.remaining_evidence: The exact foundational OWL anchor/import is selected during mapping.

dispositions.disposition: Preserve broad artifact/version endpoints; specialized reference coherence is a separate interpretation constraint.
dispositions.example: usesMethodVersion points to an ArtifactVersion whose versionOf is a method specification.
dispositions.counterexample: Do not narrow every ArtifactVersion globally to one document subtype or replace a version with its artifact.
dispositions.remaining_evidence: Qualified OWL restrictions and explicit graph joins require reviewed encodings.

dispositions.disposition: Retain all three catalog notions and all seven bridges as notes outside the native typed classes/relations.
dispositions.example: A RiskSourceReference can exist without an asserted actual source.
dispositions.counterexample: Do not promote a heterogeneous catalog notion to a typed core class merely for export completeness.
dispositions.remaining_evidence: External ontology ownership and import decisions remain separate future work.

dispositions.disposition: Retain Trigger as a specialization of actual RiskOccurrence; hypothetical trigger descriptions remain informational content.
dispositions.example: An evidenced actual trigger is an occurrence; a hypothetical scenario is not an occurrence assertion.
dispositions.counterexample: Do not infer an actual event from a scenario specification or from a mayBeRealizedBy vocabulary label.
dispositions.remaining_evidence: Causal temporal constraints and realization entailments need formal fixtures.

dispositions.disposition: Declare ten reviewed groups. All are incomplete; only person/organization identity-based subsets are declared disjoint. Other groups impose neither blanket disjointness nor covering.
dispositions.example: A person can play different roles, while a human representative and an organization remain distinct agents.
dispositions.counterexample: Do not treat an absent child classification as a contradiction or infer that all sibling pairs can overlap.
dispositions.remaining_evidence: The false disjoint flag means no blanket exclusion is asserted; it does not assert that every pair overlaps.
